Each line item is one billed service; it gives either its own unit_rate or a rate_code whose unit rate is in the rate table. The amount owed for a line is qty x unit rate. A line is UNDERPAID when paid is less than the amount owed; its shortfall is (amount owed) - paid, in currency units with two decimals. Lines paid exactly, or overpaid, are not underpayments and must not be reported as underpaid. A claim is DUPLICATED when the same claim_id appears on more than one line item (billed more than once). Find every underpaid line and every duplicated claim.
